rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for applying rules, requirements, or standards strictly.

example.english: The school enforces the exam rules stringently.
example.traditional: 學校嚴格咁執行考試規則。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 jim4 gaak3 gam3 zap1 hang4 haau2 si5 kwai1 zak1

rows.note: Use this when the stringent manner is especially harsh or severe, particularly for punishment or criticism.

example.english: The judge punished him stringently because he repeatedly broke the law.
example.traditional: 法官因為佢屢次犯法，嚴厲咁判罰佢。
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 jan1 wai6 keoi5 leoi5 ci3 faan6 faat3 jim4 lai6 gam3 pun3 fat6 keoi5
